outcome: Plasma protein expression (specifically upregulation of glucose metabolism-related proteins)
Favourable neurological outcomes (normal MR imaging or mild abnormalities) vs. unfavourable neurological outcomes
cohort: The study included 22 newborns with moderate-severe HIE who received therapeutic hypothermia, 10 newborns with mild HIE who did not, and cord blood from 10 normal births.
finding: TH-treated newborns with moderate-severe HIE who achieved favourable outcomes showed an upregulation of several glucose metabolism-related proteins in their plasma compared to those with unfavourable outcomes and other control groups.
cross-section timing: Samples (plasma and cord blood) were collected at or shortly after birth during the newborn period.
